definition: Today's documented research behind Kuiper Belt Colonies.

Icarus Interstellar is a nonprofit research network designing theoretical interstellar spacecraft. Together these programs form the ice habitats foundation that Kuiper Belt Colonies will build on — the belt propulsion results, the resource extraction methods, and the institutional memory.

title: Readiness Estimator: Kuiper Belt Colonies
definition: Estimates Kuiper Belt Colonies readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Kuiper Belt Colonies components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a belt hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Kuiper Belt Colonies operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Kuiper Belt Colonies installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 96180 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where ice habitats monitoring, belt propulsion redundancy, or resource extraction maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Kuiper Belt Colonies Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Kuiper Belt Colonies: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Kuiper Belt Colonies — settlements among the icy worlds beyond Neptune.

Phase 1 — Prove (ice habitats): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (belt propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (resource extraction): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cold operations): belt hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and Kuiper belt-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
